name: The Plaza at Harmon Meadow
summary: The Plaza at Harmon Meadow is a relaxed, open-air retail complex in Secaucus featuring a diverse mix of restaurants, a cinema, and two hotels. With its convenient Meadowlands location and comprehensive shopping and entertainment offerings, it serves as a popular destination for both local residents and regional visitors.
demographics: The Plaza at Harmon Meadow attracts a diverse mix of middle to upper-middle income shoppers from the greater Secaucus and Hudson County area, with a strong representation of young professionals and families aged 25-54. The trade area draws heavily from nearby residential communities in North Bergen, Union City, and Weehawken, as well as commuters accessing the center via its proximity to major highways and the New Jersey Turnpike. Visitors typically seek convenient shopping and dining options with a preference for national retailers and casual dining establishments. The center benefits from both local residential traffic and regional visitors drawn to the Meadowlands area for shopping and entertainment.
description: The Plaza at Harmon Meadow is a dynamic open-air retail destination located in the heart of Secaucus, New Jersey's thriving Meadowlands district. This relaxed shopping complex offers visitors a comprehensive retail and entertainment experience, featuring a carefully curated mix of fast-food and sit-down restaurants that cater to diverse tastes and preferences. The center's modern design and convenient layout make it an accessible destination for shoppers throughout the greater New York metropolitan area, with easy access from major highways including the New Jersey Turnpike. Beyond shopping and dining, The Plaza enhances the visitor experience with a full-service cinema, providing entertainment options for the whole family. The property's integration with two on-site hotels creates a unique mixed-use environment that serves both local residents and travelers, establishing The Plaza at Harmon Meadow as a cornerstone of Secaucus's commercial landscape and a popular gathering place for the community.
